product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Concrete and Glass Decor Candle Holder, 4"H, Grey
product.description: Add a modern industrial touch to your room, along with romantic candlelight, with this concrete and glass candle holder. Designed to hold a 3-inch diameter candle, the glass can be removed for a different effect, or for cleaning. 4.625" Diameter x 4.125" H An attractive décor item even when unlit Concrete base with glass cover Can be separated for cleaning
